Adjust NIS charges and costs to a reference dollar year

Source: R/cost-example.R
nis_cost.Rd

Adjust NIS charges and costs to a reference dollar year

Usage

nis_cost(data, dollars, charges = "TOTCHG")

Arguments

data

A collected data frame with YEAR, the charges column, and CCR_NIS. Lazy DuckDB queries must be collected first.

dollars

Reference dollar year, from 2012 through 2024.

charges

Name of the total-charge column. Defaults to "TOTCHG". Use "TOTCHG_2023" only knowingly: HCUP adjusts that field for states missing from 2023, so it is not comparable to earlier-year TOTCHG, and it is missing for earlier years.

Value

data with cost_adj and charges_adj in dollars USD. The in-memory data frame has nis_cost_provenance metadata; retrieve it with nis_cost_provenance().

See also

Charges, costs, and provenance.

Other costs: nis_cost_provenance()

Examples

charges <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019:2020)) |>
  dplyr::select(YEAR, TOTCHG, CCR_NIS) |>
  dplyr::collect()
